title: One or More Defendants Removed From Case

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: The charge[s] against defendant[s] ______ <insert names[s] of defendant[s]> no longer need[s] to be decided in this case.
Do not speculate about or consider in any way why the charge[s] against defendant[s] ______ <insert names[s] of defendant[s]> (do/does) not need to be decided.

bench_notes.text: The court may give this instruction if one or more of the original defendants has been removed from the case, whether through plea, dismissal, or flight.
